newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australian govt member Gibson resigns.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australian govt member Gibson resigns.

text.p: Australian Parliamentary Secretary to the Treasurer, Brian Gibson, told Parliament on Tuesday he was resigning.

"I now wish to inform the (upper house) Senate that with the greatest regreat I tendered my resignation as parliamentary secretary to the Treasurer to the Prime Minister yesterday evening," Gibson said.
Gibson, a senator from the state of Victoria, told parliament he had resigned as a result of a decision he made in June regarding Boral Ltd, in which he owned shares.

Despite having sold the majority of his Boral stock earlier this year, Gibson told parliament he still retained some shares when he approved the inclusion of a Boral subsidiary in the Victorian Electricity Exempt Futures Market.
Senator Jim Short quit as assistant treasurer on Sunday after discovering that he had granted a banking licence to a subsidiary of a bank in which he held shares.

Gibson, the member appointed to help Treasurer Peter Costello with his portfolio, said on Sunday he would sell his National Australia Bank Ltd and Bank of Melbourne Ltd shares as controversy over government members' equity investments intensified.
The Labor opposition has also targeted Industry Minister John Moore over the same issue, saying he holds shares in a venture capital company with interests crossing his portfolio.
Moore's office has said there is no conflict of interest.
